item.title: Malaysia Makes Deal With China To Stabilise Medical Devices’ Supply
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Malaysia's MDA has reached an agreement with China to increase resin and naphtha supplies for the manufacture of medical devices in Malaysia, says MOH in admitting the "direct impact" of the global energy crisis on availability of critical medical devices. The post Malaysia Makes Deal With China To Stabilise Medical Devices’ Supply appeared first on CodeBlue .
